invariant: A named note requires a participant after an optional of prefix; the prefix may be absent even when the participant itself spells of. Pair notes have two required identities and no of prefix. Attached left/right notes use a separate grammar.
causal_divergence: The combined Rust expression makes both prefix and participant optional. Its successful empty capture prevents the regex from reconsidering of as the mandatory participant and a post-match guard rejects valid inputs.
planned_change: Separate mandatory single-identity and pair expressions from attached-note expressions. Preserve single-line one-whitespace versus multiline one-or-more prefix grammar; use explicit required captures and quoted/Unicode identity grammar. Keep bare-over rejection in a separate domain check. No fixture-label branch.
perturbation_axes: identity of versus prefixed and renamed/quoted identities
